#Purpose
Reads every monthly and annual summary table that the project's .Rmd scripts save to the "output" folder (see the "save outputs" chunk in each .Rmd).

Result objects:

* `file_index`: one row per csv (timestep, time column, size)
* `monthly_tables`: named list of data frames (monthly summaries)
* `annual_tables`: named list of data frames (annual summaries)
* `all_tables`: both combined (names = file names without ".csv")

Example use: `annual_tables$AirTemperature_annual` or `monthly_tables[["Snow_monthly_by_site"]]`

#Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls()) #clear R environment

# Check for and install required packages and load libraries
for (package in c('here', 'patchwork', 'mgcv', 'nlme', 'segmented', 'tidyverse')) {    #can add more packages to this vector
  if (!require(package, character.only=T, quietly=T)) {
    install.packages(package)
    library(package, character.only=T)
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here())
```

#Files the Rmd scripts are expected to produce
```{r expected files}
out_dir <- here("output")

expected_files <- c(
  "AGBiomass_annual.csv",
  "AirTemperature_monthly.csv",
  "AirTemperature_annual.csv",
  "AtmPrecipChem_annual_wateryear.csv",
  "AtmPrecipChem_annual_calendaryear.csv",
  "AtmPrecipChem_monthly.csv",
  "Litterfall_annual.csv",
  "LysimeterW1_monthly.csv",
  "LysimeterW1_annual.csv",
  "LysimeterW6_monthly.csv",
  "LysimeterW6_annual.csv",
  "Snow_monthly.csv",
  "Snow_annual.csv",
  "SoilMicrobialBiomass_annual.csv",
  "StreamChemW6_VWM_monthly.csv",
  "StreamChemW6_VWM_annual.csv",
  "SoilGasFlux_annual.csv",
  "SoilGasFlux_monthly.csv"
)
```

#Find the csv files
```{r find csv files}
csv_files <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(csv_files) == 0) {
  stop("No .csv files found in ", out_dir,
       ". Run the .Rmd scripts first so they write their outputs.")
}

# Tell the user which scripts have not been run yet (or produced nothing)
missing_files <- setdiff(expected_files, basename(csv_files))
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  message("Note: ", length(missing_files), " expected file(s) not found in output/:\n  ",
          paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n  "))
}

# Files in output/ that this script did not expect (e.g. added by hand later)
extra_files <- setdiff(basename(csv_files), expected_files)
if (length(extra_files) > 0) {
  message("Note: also reading ", length(extra_files), " file(s) not on the expected list:\n  ",
          paste(extra_files, collapse = "\n  "))
}
```

#Read them all in
guess_max = Inf so column types are decided from the whole file, not just the first 1000 rows (several tables have long runs of NA at the start).
```{r read csv files}
names(csv_files) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(csv_files))

all_tables <- map(csv_files, read_csv, guess_max = Inf, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

#Index of what was read
```{r file index}
time_cols <- c("month", "year", "waterYr")  # time column names used across scripts

file_index <- tibble(
  table    = names(all_tables),
  file     = basename(csv_files),
  timestep = case_when(
    str_detect(table, "_monthly") ~ "monthly",
    str_detect(table, "_annual")  ~ "annual",
    TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
  ),
  time_col = map_chr(all_tables, function(df) {
    hit <- intersect(time_cols, names(df))
    if (length(hit) > 0) hit[1] else NA_character_
  }),
  n_rows   = map_int(all_tables, nrow),
  n_cols   = map_int(all_tables, ncol)
) %>%
  arrange(timestep, table)

if (any(is.na(file_index$timestep))) {
  warning("Could not tell monthly from annual for: ",
          paste(file_index$table[is.na(file_index$timestep)], collapse = ", "))
}

print(file_index, n = Inf)
```

#Split into monthly and annual lists
```{r split monthly and annual}
monthly_tables <- all_tables[file_index$table[file_index$timestep %in% "monthly"]]
annual_tables  <- all_tables[file_index$table[file_index$timestep %in% "annual"]]
```

##Notes
* read_csv() returns text columns as character, so factor columns saved by the scripts (e.g. ordered soil Horizon in SoilMicrobialBiomass_annual) come back as character. Re-apply factor levels if you need the original ordering.
* Date columns (month, year in the monthly/annual tables built with floor_date()) are read back as Date; year/Year/YEAR/waterYr in other tables are numeric. waterYr is a water year, not a calendar year.

#For annual tables, harmonize the elevations and yearly timesteps
```{r}
#View(annual_tables$AirTemperature_annual)

annual_tables$AirTemperature_annual <- annual_tables$AirTemperature_annual %>%
  mutate(
    station     = str_extract(STA, "^[^\n]+"),               # HQ, STA1, STA23, ...
    elevation_m = as.numeric(str_extract(STA, "\\d+(?= m$)")),  # 255, 478, 668, ...
    Elev_group  = case_when(elevation_m >= 710 ~ "Upper",
                            elevation_m >= 630 ~ "Middle",
                            elevation_m <  630 ~ "Lower"),
    Elev_group  = factor(Elev_group, levels = c("Upper", "Middle", "Lower"))
  )

#str(annual_tables$AGBiomass_annual) #groups assigned in input code, check for correct elevation cutoffs

annual_tables$AGBiomass_annual <- annual_tables$AGBiomass_annual %>% 
  mutate( year = as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01")))

#str(annual_tables$SoilMicrobialBiomass_annual)
annual_tables$SoilMicrobialBiomass_annual <- annual_tables$SoilMicrobialBiomass_annual %>% 
  mutate( Elev_group  = case_when(elev >= 710 ~ "Upper",
                            elev >= 630 ~ "Middle",
                            elev <  630 ~ "Lower"),
    Elev_group  = factor(Elev_group, levels = c("Upper", "Middle", "Lower")),
    year = as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01"))
  )
  
#str(annual_tables$Litterfall_annual) #groups assigned before uploaded to EDI, so need to look into how to get actual elevations
elev_map <- c(Low = "Lower", Mid = "Middle", High = "Upper", Upper = "Upper")
annual_tables$Litterfall_annual <- annual_tables$Litterfall_annual %>%
  mutate(year = as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01")),
         Elev_group = factor(elev_map[elev], levels = c("Upper", "Middle", "Lower")))

#str(annual_tables$SoilGasFlux_annual) #groups assigned before uploaded to EDI, so need to look into how to get actual elevations
elev_map <- c(low = "Lower", mid = "Middle", high = "Upper", "spruce/fir" = "Upper")
annual_tables$Litterfall_annual <- annual_tables$Litterfall_annual %>%
  mutate(Elev_group = factor(elev_map[elev], levels = c("Upper", "Middle", "Lower")))

#str(annual_tables$Snow_annual) #based elevation on core stations (Site) in data frame with known elevations
snow_elev <- tribble(
  ~Site,   ~elevation_m, ~elev_source,
  "STAHQ", 255,          "Snow script table",
  "STA1",  478,          "Assumed from air temperature station",
  "STA2",  560,          "Snow script table",
  "STA19", 600,          "Snow script table",
  "STA6",  732,          "Assumed from air temperature station",
  "STA14", 732,          "Assumed from air temperature station",
  "STA9",  778,          "Snow script table",
  "STA17", 898,          "Snow script table"
)

annual_tables$Snow_annual <- annual_tables$Snow_annual %>%
  left_join(snow_elev, by = "Site") %>%
  mutate(Elev_group = case_when(elevation_m >= 710 ~ "Upper",
                                elevation_m >= 630 ~ "Middle",
                                elevation_m <  630 ~ "Lower"),
         Elev_group = factor(Elev_group, levels = c("Upper", "Middle", "Lower")))

```

#Combine Lysimeter dataframes together
```{r}
annual_tables$Lysimeter_annual <- bind_rows(
  annual_tables$LysimeterW1_annual %>% mutate(Site = "W1"),
  annual_tables$LysimeterW6_annual %>% mutate(Site = "W6")) %>%
  mutate(Site = factor(Site, levels = c("W1", "W6"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, Site, everything(), -WS)   # Site replaces the numeric WS column

annual_tables$Lysimeter_annual %>% count(Site)

#str(annual_tables$Lysimeter_annual)
```
##Temp fixes of issues in datasets
```{r}
annual_tables$AtmPrecipChem_annual_calendaryear <- annual_tables$AtmPrecipChem_annual_calendaryear %>% 
  mutate(DOC_mean = if_else(DOC_mean < 0.0001, NA, DOC_mean))

annual_tables$StreamChemW6_VWM_annual <- annual_tables$StreamChemW6_VWM_annual %>% 
  mutate(DOC_vwm = if_else(DOC_vwm < 0.0001, NA, DOC_vwm),
         DIC_vwm = if_else(DIC_vwm < 0.0001, NA, DIC_vwm))
```




#Abiotic trends
```{r graph settings}
start_date <- as.Date("1980-01-01")
end_date   <- as.Date("2025-01-01")
x_scale <- scale_x_date(limits = c(start_date, end_date),
                           date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y",
                           ) #expand = c(0, 0)
```

##pH
```{r}

#Atmospheric precipitation, by rain gauge (calendar year)
atm_plot <- annual_tables$AtmPrecipChem_annual_calendaryear %>%
  filter(year >= start_date, !is.na(pH_mean)) %>%
  select(year, site, pH = pH_mean) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pH, shape = site)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8, color="black") +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), color = "black",
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  x_scale +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Precipitation pH",
       color = "Rain gauge", shape = "Rain gauge",
       title = "Precipitation pH 1980 to present") +
  theme_classic()

atm_plot 

#Soil
soil_plot <- annual_tables$SoilMicrobialBiomass_annual %>%
 filter(year >= start_date, !is.na(pH_mean)) %>%
  group_by(year, Elev_group, Hor) %>%
  summarise(pH = mean(pH_mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pH, shape = Hor, color = Elev_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(linetype = Hor, color=Elev_group, group = interaction(Elev_group, Hor)),
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Upper = "orange", Lower = "red")) +
  x_scale +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Soil pH",
       color = "Elevation", shape = "Horizon Type", linetype = "Elevation",
       title = "Soil pH by horizon type and elevation, 1980 to present") +
  theme_classic()

soil_plot #This is messy, leave out for now

#Soil solution

lys_plot <- annual_tables$Lysimeter_annual %>%
  filter(year >= start_date, !is.na(pH_mean)) %>%
  group_by(year, Site, Horizon_type) %>%
  summarise(pH = mean(pH_mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pH, shape = Horizon_type, color = Site)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(linetype = Horizon_type, group = interaction(Site, Horizon_type)),
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(W6 = "#8c510a", W1 = "#01665e")) +
  x_scale +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Soil solution pH",
       color = "Watershed", shape = "Horizon Type", linetype = "Horizon Type",
       title = "Soil solution pH by horizon type, 1980 to present") +
  theme_classic()

lys_plot


stream_plot <- annual_tables$Lysimeter_annual %>%
  filter(year >= start_date, !is.na(pH_mean)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pH_mean, color = Site)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = Site), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(W6 = "#8c510a", W1 = "#01665e")) +
  x_scale +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Stream pH (volume-weighted)",
       color = "Watershed",
       title = "Stream pH by watershed, 1980 to present") +
  theme_classic()

stream_plot

pH_all <- atm_plot / lys_plot / stream_plot + plot_layout(guides = "collect")

pH_all

dir.create(here("Graphs"), showWarnings = FALSE)

plots  <- list(atm_plot, lys_plot, stream_plot, pH_all)
names  <- c("pH_trend_precipitation", "pH_trend_lysimeter", "pH_trend_stream_W6", "pH_trend_all")
heights <- c(5, 5, 5, 15)

for (i in seq_along(plots)) {
  ggsave(
    filename = here::here("Graphs", paste0(names[i], ".png")),
    plot = plots[[i]],
    width = 10,
    height = heights[i],
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```
